quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #23
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: In a vehicle without an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), you should pump your brakes to slow down because:

options.text: It keeps air out of the brake line.
It prevents tires from going bald.

questions.explanation: Pump the brakes gently on slippery surfaces. If your vehicle has ABS, read your manual to learn how to use it.

questions.question: If an oncoming vehicle has high beams on, look toward ____ of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road if bright headlights blind you. This helps you stay in your lane until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance ramp, you should:

options.text: Enter faster than traffic to get ahead.
Enter slowly to avoid other vehicles.
Stop first, then slowly enter traffic.
Speed up to match the traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the entrance ramp to speed up and match traffic. Signal, check for an opening, and merge into a gap safely.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow arrow on a traffic signal, you:

options.text: Should merge into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
May turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
Have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow means you can turn in that direction. You must yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians first.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: Your vehicle is blocking traffic after an accident. You should:

options.text: Move your vehicle off the road if you can.
Do not move your vehicle under any circumstances.
Wait for police before moving your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle off the road if you can.
questions.explanation: Move your vehicle off the road after a minor accident if possible. Stay at the scene. Give your information and offer help if needed.

questions.question: From top to bottom, traffic lights are ordered:
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is on top and green is on the bottom. On a horizontal light, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: The school zone speed limit is:
questions.explanation: The speed limit in school zones is 20 mph. Always drive slowly and carefully in areas where children may be present.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand extended downward means they plan to:
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Prepare to slow down if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: A slow-moving vehicle emblem is:
questions.explanation: A slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this emblem travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: If you drive without valid liability insurance, your license will be suspended for at least:
questions.explanation: All vehicles must have liability insurance. If you have an accident without insurance or do not show proof of insurance within 15 days, your license will be suspended for at least 90 days.

questions.question: An oncoming driver is heading toward you in your lane. What should you do?

options.text: Blow your horn, steer right, and speed up.
Blow your horn, steer left, and brake.
Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay in the center of your lane, blow your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: Honk your horn to get the other driver's attention. If they do not move, steer right to avoid them. Do not steer left because the other driver may also correct at the last moment and you will still collide. Brake firmly and steadily. Slowing down by each mile per hour reduces the impact.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot of a large vehicle.
An area designated for motor vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle.
questions.explanation: A "No zone" is the blind spot around trucks and large vehicles where drivers cannot see smaller vehicles. Avoid staying in these areas around large vehicles.

questions.question: What is true about a work zone?

options.text: It may be moving or stationary.
It is marked with black and white signs.
You do not need to slow down or pay extra attention.

questions.correctAnswerText: It may be moving or stationary.
questions.explanation: Work zones can stay in one place or move (such as vehicles striping lines, mowing, or removing snow). Work zones are marked with orange signs with black letters or symbols. Always slow down and pay close attention in work zones.

questions.question: Traffic signals use arrows to control turns from specific lanes. A solid yellow arrow means:

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It has the same meaning as a yellow circular traffic light.
You may turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
A green arrow is about to appear.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has the same meaning as a yellow circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same thing as a regular yellow traffic light. Slow down and be ready for a red light.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light has the same meaning as a:
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and go only when it is safe. A stop sign may also be posted at this location.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, what should you do?

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill with a curb, turn your wheels sharply to the left, away from the curb. If your brakes fail, your vehicle will roll into the curb instead of into traffic.

questions.question: A single dashed white line on a multilane road means:

options.text: Lanes are moving in opposite directions.
You may pass into a lane next to the dashed white line.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass into a lane next to the dashed white line.
questions.explanation: Single dashed white lines separate lanes where changing lanes is allowed. White lines separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling that they plan to turn right. Adjust your driving if you are following a vehicle using this hand signal.
